title: Letterboxes
narration: An SVG keeps its own aspect ratio inside the slot. A tall view box is centred horizontally, a wide one with a negative origin is centred vertically, and paths may use arcs and curves with nested transforms.

elements.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 10 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="1" y="1" width="8" height="98" stroke="accent2" fill="none"/><line x1="5" y1="1" x2="5" y2="99" stroke="muted"/><circle cx="5" cy="20" r="3" stroke="accent1" fill="accent1"/><circle cx="5" cy="50" r="3" stroke="accent3" fill="none"/><circle cx="5" cy="80" r="3" stroke="accent4" fill="accent4"/></svg>

<svg viewBox="-50 -5 100 10" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><line x1="-50" y1="0" x2="50" y2="0" stroke="chalk"/><polyline points="-45,-4 -30,4 -15,-4 0,4 15,-4 30,4 45,-4" stroke="accent5" fill="none"/><g transform="translate(-40,0) scale(0.5)"><rect x="0" y="-8" width="10" height="16" stroke="accent2" fill="accent2"/></g><text x="0" y="-2" font-size="3" text-anchor="middle" fill="accent1">wide view box</text></svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 80 C 30 10, 70 10, 90 80" stroke="accent1" fill="none"/><path d="M10 50 Q 50 0 90 50" stroke="accent2" fill="none"/><path d="M20 90 A 30 30 0 0 1 80 90" stroke="accent3" fill="none"/><g transform="translate(50,50)"><g transform="rotate(45)"><rect x="-10" y="-10" width="20" height="20" stroke="accent4" fill="accent4"/></g></g><text x="50" y="20" font-size="6" text-anchor="middle" fill="chalk">arcs and curves</text></svg>
